text: faint: Heb. be tender | tremble: Heb. make haste
eaten of it: Heb. made it common
to lead the people: Heb. to be in the head of the people
for the tree of the field mans life: Or, for, O man the tree of the field is to be employed in the seige | to employ them: Heb. to go from before thee
it be subdued: Heb. it come down
